intro: Floyd is a versatile, thoughtfully designed workspace for teenagers. Its sleek functionality and customisable features make it perfect, whether you’re studying, creating, or organising your space.

features.title: Smart storage for everything you need
features.text: With drawers, open shelves, and a hinged unit, it holds books, gadgets, and daily essentials, making organization effortless.

features.title: Warm, inviting, and effortlessly stylish
features.text: The rich brown tone complements a variety of decor styles, adding a warm, sophisticated touch to your room.

features.title: More space when inspiration strikes
features.text: A spacious work surface accommodates laptops, books, and more, creating a productive and clutter-free environment.

features.title: Minimal effort, maximum style
features.text: Effortlessly stylish and easy to clean, it’s the perfect choice for modern, fuss-free living.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
